author: Atlas
change_details: Jeremy directly clarified that Atlas executes all symbols and time horizons and owns the authoritative account-wide native trading history. Scout research-symbol assignments are not separate trading-history ownership.

The former Scout native export and two-ledger migration requirement is superseded as an Atlas startup prerequisite. Preserve old records but do not combine/import a peer book or require an export to start Atlas.

The explicit local manual-start declaration selects a truthful sole-executor initialization receipt. Atlas native accounting is preserved unchanged; the normal worker performs account capture, reconciliation and existing execution guards.
Readiness separates ordinary worker reconciliation findings from manual launch readiness and recognizes a living DEGRADED session after verifying its process, lock and heartbeat.
limitations: Main integration and Scout source installation are separate from verified publication.
Private declarations, account state, ledger contents, financial values, snapshots, raw broker replies, credentials and models are excluded.
Historical source and request records remain preserved; this source notice is not an acknowledgment or a new export request.
runtime_implications: Atlas local human manually starts the existing command. No Scout history dependency, duplicate prelaunch account capture or new approval ceremony. Source is installed on Atlas; publication does not authorize any peer operating change. Normal execution engine and broker/order controls are unchanged. Existing task identities and schedules are retained.
summary: Restore Atlas sole-executor startup and retire the erroneous Scout-history prerequisite
